title: The Banach-Tarski paradox in complete discretely valued fields
summary: We prove some results related to the classical Banach--Tarski paradox in the setting of a field $\mathbb{K}$ that is complete with respect to a discrete non-Archimedean valuation (e.g., when $\mathbb{K}$ is the field $\mathbb{Q}_p$ of $p$-adic numbers for a prime $p$). Namely, the field $\mathbb{K}$, as well as all balls and spheres in $\mathbb{K}$, admit a paradoxical decomposition with respect to the isometry group of $\mathbb{K}$.
